descriptionHtml:
Onikuma CW932 Wireless Vertical Ergonomic Mouse with 2400 DPI - Black Edition

Say goodbye to wrist fatigue and elevate your daily tracking comfort with the premium Onikuma CW932 Wireless Vertical Ergonomic Mouse in Sleek Black. Available at Turbo Computer, this advanced PC hardware peripheral is masterfully engineered for long-hour office workers, digital web managers, and casual gamers across Egypt who experience muscle strain. Featuring a scientific vertical contour layout that mimics a natural handshake position, it significantly reduces wrist tension, allowing you to execute tasks fluidly. Backed by an exceptional official 2-year warranty, it provides ultimate long-term reliability and absolute peace of mind.

The Onikuma CW932 Black is packed with intelligent multi-device capabilities, powered by a versatile Tri-Mode wireless framework (2.4GHz via USB receiver + Bluetooth 1 + Bluetooth 2) that connects up to 3 separate devices simultaneously. It features a responsive optical tracking sensor with a 4-stage adjustable layout up to 2400 DPI, tailored for exact cross-screen navigation. Armed with 8 functional keys, including a unique multifunction button setup, it optimizes your workspace productivity pathways. Equipped with a built-in 500mAh rechargeable battery, it delivers an ultra-long operational lifespan, operating up to 48 hours with lights off, making it a perfect tool for modern workspace setups.
